name: My Hypnotized Family
source:
In this story you are a young psychology major, who manages to lose his job, his girlfriend and a place to live all in a matter of two months and is forced to go back to live with his family: a curvy nurse in her 40s and her two daughters (both over 18, naturally).

The older daughter seems to hate your guts, dresses in gothic style and wears long dark fingernails.

The younger sister is much more naïve, cute, sweet and kind. She is very close to you, loves candy, stuffed animals and everything pink. Fortune allows you to get acquainted with a local hypnotherapist, and being a psychology graduate, you are hired to be her assistant. Every day you observe how she hypnotizes her patients. The more you see her do it, the more tempting it becomes to hypnotize the women at home as well…

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/thenaughtythree]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事中，你是一名年輕的心理學專業畢業生，短短兩個月內，接連失去工作、女友與住處，被迫回家與家人同住：一位40多歲、身材豐腴的護士，以及她的兩個女兒，當然，兩人都已年滿18歲。

大女兒似乎對你深惡痛絕，穿著哥德風格的衣服，留著長長的深色指甲。

小女兒則天真得多，可愛、甜美、善良。她與你十分親近，喜歡糖果、絨毛玩偶，以及一切粉色的東西。機緣巧合，你結識了當地一位催眠治療師。由於擁有心理學背景，你被聘為她的助手。每天，你都會觀察她如何催眠患者。看得越多，你就越難抗拒一個念頭：也對家裡的女性施以催眠……

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/thenaughtythree]Patreon[/url]]
